title: chore(news): remove the reddit tone and last reddit mentions
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed the unused Reddit tone prompt after Reddit was taken out of the news pipeline in #17308. The gist and daily-summary prompts now refer to the X post generator and weekly platforms instead of Reddit. The architecture diagram no longer shows a Reddit VPS, and PIPELINE.md says Reddit posting will start fresh later. The public subreddit link remains in brand/links.md. A practice run for the 2026-10-12 daily summary produced new wording but kept its five arcs and five highlights: model, API, product, product, and app.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel-art garden shed, Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; small-to-medium in the frame and wearing tiny editor glasses, she sets an unused Reddit tone card on a shelf beside a retro terminal showing an X card and weekly post cards, with code-plants and flowers nearby. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), a warm cream background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, chunky sprites, and a gentle CRT glow.
